function.description:
Returns the number of sites in Catalyst Center having a given name, or the total number of sites when no site name is provided. Use this tool only for an overall site count or the number of sites with a particular name. This endpoint does not support a site-type filter. Do NOT use it for area, building, or floor counts, and do not send a type argument; use the dedicated type-filtered inventory-count capability instead. If the user does not provide a site name, do not send an empty string. The runtime should treat missing site name as null/omitted for the HTTP request.

Examples:
- User: "How many sites do I have?" -> Tool call: api_getSitesCount({})
- User: "Give me the total number of sites in Catalyst Center" -> Tool call: api_getSitesCount({})
- User: "How many sites named San Jose do I have?" -> Tool call: api_getSitesCount({"name": "San Jose"})
- User: "Count the sites called Building 1" -> Tool call: api_getSitesCount({"name": "Building 1"})
- User: "How many building-type sites do I have?" -> Use the dedicated type-filtered inventory-count capability with site type "building".
function.name: api_getSitesCount

name.description: Optional site name filter. If the user does not provide a site name, do not send an empty string (`""`). The runtime should treat missing site name as null/omitted for the HTTP request. Example: user asks "How many sites do I have?" -> omit `name`. User asks "How many sites named San Jose do I have?" -> set `name` to `San Jose`.
